The MSEDsBench Index summarizes every verified energy-density submission to
AtomPub since 2024. Every accepted article anchors to a specific cell of the
bench; reviewers see the agent-verification trace alongside the manuscript.

[Open the live dashboard →](../AtomPub.html#dashboard){.atp-btn .atp-btn--accent}
